description: This header file declares utility functions for managing disk cache entries, including hash key conversions, filename generation, size calculations, and file deletion, within the simple disk cache implementation of Chromium.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker::EntryFileKey
classes.description: A class representing a key for a file entry in the simple cache.

methods.name: ConvertEntryHashKeyToHexString
methods.description: Converts a uint64 hash key to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKeyAsHexString
methods.description: Returns the hex string of the hash key for a given cache key.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKey
methods.description: Computes the uint64 hash of a cache key.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKeyFromHexString
methods.description: Parses a hex string into a uint64 hash key.

methods.name: GetFilenameFromKeyAndFileIndex
methods.description: Generates filename for a stream based on cache key and file index.

methods.name: GetFilenameFromEntryFileKeyAndFileIndex
methods.description: Generates filename for a stream based on an entry file key and file index.

methods.name: GetSparseFilenameFromEntryFileKey
methods.description: Returns filename for sparse data associated with an entry.

methods.name: GetHeaderSize
methods.description: Returns size of cache file header based on key length.

methods.name: GetDataSizeFromFileSize
methods.description: Calculates stream data size from file size.

methods.name: GetFileSizeFromDataSize
methods.description: Calculates total file size from stream data size.

methods.name: GetFileIndexFromStreamIndex
methods.description: Maps stream index to file index.

methods.name: SimpleCacheDeleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a cache file with POSIX semantics.

methods.name: IncrementalCrc32
methods.description: Updates CRC32 checksum with additional data.
